Character sprites extracted from Raspberry Cube.

This gallery contains all full-body character sprites from the `ei` and
`ma` asset groups, including both H and non-H variants. Since each group
contains only a limited number of images, they have been combined into
a single gallery.

This gallery represents only a small subset of the game's complete
character-sprite resources.
